skill.name: TikTok 视频下载地址获取

videoUrl.title: TikTok video URL
videoUrl.description: Supports official TikTok video URLs and official vm.tiktok.com / vt.tiktok.com short links.

addressPreference.title: Preferred URL type
addressPreference.description: download prefers the original download URL; playback prefers the playback URL.

allowFallback.title: Use fallback URL if preferred URL is unavailable
allowFallback.description: When disabled, report an error if the preferred URL is unavailable instead of returning the other type.

waitSeconds.title: Page wait time (seconds)
waitSeconds.description: Wait for video details and URLs to load. Increase this value on slower networks.

saveResults.title: Save video record to Tobub
saveResults.description: When enabled, save the video and URL metadata. When disabled, return this run’s result only.

fields.label: TikTok video URL
fields.description: Enter an official TikTok video URL or short link.

fields.label: Preferred URL type
fields.description: Choose whether to prefer the download URL or playback URL.

fields.label: Use fallback URL if preferred URL is unavailable
fields.description: When disabled, the Skill will not fall back to the other URL type.

fields.label: Page wait time (seconds)
fields.description: Wait for video details to load; increase this value on slower networks.

fields.label: Save video record to Tobub
fields.description: When enabled, save the record; otherwise return results only.

metadata.description: 提取 TikTok 视频首屏提供的下载或播放地址，可选择优先类型、备用回退和等待时间；支持关闭记录保存。
